mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50 for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in industrial activity that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 50 for 2 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (> 0.5pp over 3 months) signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will pressure consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate exceeds 3% and the Fed funds rate is below 2%, it signals a high-inflation/low-rate environment that will erode real yields and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 3% and FEDFUNDS < 2% but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) both show y-o-y declines of > 5%, it signals a broad-based demand slowdown that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 5% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by > 200k jobs per month for 3 consecutive months, it signals a tightening labor market that will boost wage growth and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS > 200k for 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (INDPRO) rises above 60 for two consecutive months, it signals a rapid acceleration in industrial activity that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 60 for 2 months but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the Fed funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) is below 2%, it signals a high-rate/low-inflation environment that will boost real yields and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 5% and CPIAUCSL < 2% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of triggered instances.
